## Smoke Test Scope / 冒烟测试范围

Critical paths to verify before QA hand-off (run via `/smoke-check`): / 在QA移交前验证的关键路径（通过`/smoke-check`运行）：

1. Game launches to main menu without crash / 游戏启动到主菜单不崩溃
2. New game / session can be started / 可以开始新游戏/会话
3. [Primary mechanic introduced or changed this sprint] / [本次冲刺引入或更改的主要机制]
4. [System with regression risk from this sprint's changes] / [因本次冲刺更改存在回归风险的系统]
5. Save / load cycle completes without data loss (if save system exists) / 保存/加载循环完成无数据丢失（如果存在保存系统）
6. Performance is within budget on target hardware / 在目标硬件上的性能在预算范围内

## Definition of Done — This Sprint / 完成定义 — 本次冲刺

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true: / 当以下所有条件都满足时，故事才算完成：

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — automated test result OR documented manual evidence / [ ] 所有验收标准已验证——自动化测试结果或文档化手动证据
- [ ] Test file exists for all Logic and Integration stories and passes / [ ] 所有逻辑和集成故事都有测试文件并通过
- [ ] Manual evidence document exists for all Visual/Feel and UI stories / [ ] 所有视觉/手感和界面故事都有手动证据文档
- [ ] Smoke check passes (run `/smoke-check sprint` before QA hand-off) / [ ] 冒烟检查通过（在QA移交前运行`/smoke-check sprint`）
- [ ] No regressions introduced — previous sprint's features still pass / [ ] 未引入回归——之前冲刺的功能仍然通过
- [ ] Code reviewed (via `/code-review` or documented peer review) / [ ] 代码已审阅（通过`/code-review`或文档化的同行审阅）
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` via `/story-done` / [ ] 通过`/story-done`将故事文件更新为`Status: Complete`

**Stories requiring playtest sign-off before close**: [list, or "None"] / **需要在关闭前获得游戏测试签字的业务**：[列表，或"无"]
